f3_program: observe(at("company.cash_flow_hedge_gains_recognized_in_other_comprehensive_income", "2018"), 219, "million_currency", cell("Gains recognized in other comprehensive income (loss), net of tax of $1, $11, and $4", "2018"))

observe(at("company.cash_flow_hedge_gains_recognized_in_other_comprehensive_income", "2019"), 159, "million_currency", cell("Gains recognized in other comprehensive income (loss), net of tax of $1, $11, and $4", "2019"))
query("percentage_change", at("company.cash_flow_hedge_gains_recognized_in_other_comprehensive_income", "2018"), at("company.cash_flow_hedge_gains_recognized_in_other_comprehensive_income", "2019"))
collection("kayden_business.delivery_customers", "customer", "different_towns", source("four of its customers in different towns"))
collection("kayden_business.processed_milk_cartons", "milk_carton", "kayden_business", source("the 400 cartons of milk it had processed"))

collection("kayden_business.delivered_milk_cartons", "milk_carton", "kayden_business.delivery_customers", source("delivered an equal number of the 400 cartons of milk it had processed to four of its customers in different towns"))
observe(at("kayden_business.processed_milk_cartons.count", "before_delivery"), 400, "count", source("the 400 cartons of milk it had processed"))
observe(at("kayden_business.delivery_customers.count", "delivery"), 4, "count", source("four of its customers"))

same(at("kayden_business.delivered_milk_cartons.count", "initial"), at("kayden_business.processed_milk_cartons.count", "before_delivery"), source("delivered an equal number of the 400 cartons of milk it had processed to four of its customers in different towns"))

quotient_relation(at("kayden_business.delivered_milk_cartons.per_customer.count", "delivery"), at("kayden_business.delivered_milk_cartons.count", "initial"), at("kayden_business.delivery_customers.count", "delivery"), source("delivered an equal number of the 400 cartons of milk it had processed to four of its customers"))
observe(at("kayden_business.returned_milk_cartons.per_customer.count", "during_delivery"), 60, "count", source("each of the four customers returned 60 cartons damaged during delivery"))

product_relation(at("kayden_business.returned_milk_cartons.count", "during_delivery"), at("kayden_business.delivery_customers.count", "delivery"), at("kayden_business.returned_milk_cartons.per_customer.count", "during_delivery"), source("each of the four customers returned 60 cartons damaged during delivery"))

remove("damaged_returns", "kayden_business.delivery_customers", at("kayden_business.delivered_milk_cartons.count", "current"), at("kayden_business.returned_milk_cartons.count", "during_delivery"), source("each of the four customers returned 60 cartons damaged during delivery"))
query("remaining_count", "kayden_business.delivered_milk_cartons", "current")
collection("afternoon.pennies_thrown", "penny", "fountain", source("Rachelle, Gretchen and Rocky threw pennies into the fountain"))
member("afternoon.pennies_thrown", "afternoon.pennies_thrown.rachelle", source("Rachelle threw 180 pennies into the fountain"))
member("afternoon.pennies_thrown", "afternoon.pennies_thrown.gretchen", source("Gretchen threw half as many pennies into the fountain as Rachelle"))
member("afternoon.pennies_thrown", "afternoon.pennies_thrown.rocky", source("Rocky threw in one-third as many pennies as Gretchen"))
observe(at("afternoon.pennies_thrown.rachelle.count", "afternoon"), 180, "count", source("Rachelle threw 180 pennies into the fountain"))

fraction_of(at("afternoon.pennies_thrown.gretchen.count", "afternoon"), at("afternoon.pennies_thrown.rachelle.count", "afternoon"), 1, 2, source("Gretchen threw half as many pennies into the fountain as Rachelle"))
fraction_of(at("afternoon.pennies_thrown.rocky.count", "afternoon"), at("afternoon.pennies_thrown.gretchen.count", "afternoon"), 1, 3, source("Rocky threw in one-third as many pennies as Gretchen"))
query("sum", "afternoon.pennies_thrown", "afternoon")
collection("jim.model_cars", "model_car", "jim", source("Jim collects model cars"))
member("jim.model_cars", "jim.model_cars.buick", source("Jim has 4 times as many Buicks as Fords"))
member("jim.model_cars", "jim.model_cars.ford", source("Jim has 4 times as many Buicks as Fords"))
member("jim.model_cars", "jim.model_cars.chevy", source("3 more than twice the number of Fords than Chevys"))
observe(at("jim.model_cars.count", "current"), 301, "count", source("he has 301 models total"))
partition("jim.model_cars", at("jim.model_cars.count", "current"), source("Jim collects model cars, and he has 301 models total"))
multiple(at("jim.model_cars.buick.count", "current"), at("jim.model_cars.ford.count", "current"), 4, source("4 times as many Buicks as Fords"))
offset(at("jim.model_cars.ford.count", "current"), scale(at("jim.model_cars.chevy.count", "current"), 2), 3, "count", source("3 more than twice the number of Fords than Chevys"))
query("value", at("jim.model_cars.buick.count", "current"))
assumptions: The three named makes form the model-car partition referenced by the stated total.
